question_intent: Host asks where the motivation came from to revive the Red Lion and Sun name and work outside Iran.
complete_question_core: در پی احیای این نام ارزشمند جمعیت شیر و خورشید سرخ ایران فعالیت را آغاز می‌کنید بیرون ایران. این انگیزه از کجا آمده.
main_answer: He had lost connection after the conversion to Red Crescent; Bam jolted him back; he re-entered the (renamed) structure, then was forced into exile in Germany, restored the name/flag, and registered an official association there.
required_reasoning: Lost interest after conversion — otherwise 'ولی وقتی زلزله بم' has no referent.
Re-entering the Red Crescent structure (the renamed body).
Official German association registration as the revival's concrete close.
required_context: Revival is the guest's path (Bam, exile, Germany), not universal recognition.
The revived name is شیر و خورشید سرخ ایران.
qualifications: Registration in Germany is the guest's claim of a legal association, not ICRC recognition.
Bam is a personal jolt, not a proof that revival was inevitable.
conclusion_payoff: After a long process they registered an official association in Germany under the lion-and-sun name.

a reason (threats / physical harm) and that he was inside the structure
